communities.name: Tel Aviv-Yafo
communities.rules: Arrange a pickup time before heading out. Keep shared entrances clear while handing things over.

communities.name: Haifa
communities.rules: Agree on a convenient meeting spot together. Mention stairs or a steep walk if the item is heavy.

communities.name: Be'er Sheva
communities.rules: Choose a shaded meeting spot for daytime pickups. Send a quick update if you are running late.

communities.name: Florentin
communities.rules: Keep late pickups quiet around shared lobbies.

communities.name: Tel Aviv University
communities.rules: Meet outside the campus gate unless you have both agreed otherwise.

communities.name: Musicians
communities.rules: Try the gear together before pickup. Return cables neatly coiled and keep instruments in their cases.

communities.name: Students
communities.rules: Share what you need for your project and when it is due. Leave time for the next person to collect the item.

communities.name: Builders and DIY
communities.rules: Ask about unfamiliar tools before using them. Return bits and accessories in their labelled compartments.

communities.name: Office and study
communities.rules: Keep borrowed equipment away from drinks. Remove your notes and papers before returning it.

communities.name: Outdoor and camping
communities.rules: Air and dry outdoor gear before packing it. Tell the owner about any damage after a trip.

communities.name: Parents and kids
communities.rules: Check the suggested age with the owner. Count small parts together and supervise children during use.

looking_for.author: u12
looking_for.title: Two-person tent for a short hike
looking_for.body: A friend and I are trying a nearby campsite. A simple tent with a groundsheet would be ideal.

looking_for.author: u13
looking_for.title: Keyboard for a rehearsal afternoon
looking_for.body: Our usual practice room is closed this week. A portable keyboard with its power supply would help.

looking_for.author: u14
looking_for.title: Drill for a pair of wall shelves
looking_for.body: I have the fixings and would appreciate a drill with masonry bits. Happy to collect in the evening.

looking_for.author: u15
looking_for.title: Projector for a family film night
looking_for.body: We have a blank wall and a quiet room ready. A cable for a laptop would be useful too.

looking_for.author: u16
looking_for.title: Sewing machine for curtain hems
looking_for.body: I only need a straight stitch for two curtains. A quick reminder about threading would be welcome.

looking_for.author: u17
looking_for.title: Folding table for a study group
looking_for.body: Four of us need a little more desk space. It needs to fit through a normal doorway.

looking_for.author: u18
looking_for.title: Large pot for a shared dinner
looking_for.body: We are making soup for a small group. A lid and easy-to-carry handles would be helpful.

looking_for.author: u19
looking_for.title: Sleeping mats for visiting friends
looking_for.body: Two friends are staying over and floor space is available. Foam mats are completely fine.

looking_for.author: u20
looking_for.title: Tripod for recording a presentation
looking_for.body: I need a stable phone mount for a short course assignment. It will stay indoors.

looking_for.author: u21
looking_for.title: Board game for a mixed-age evening
looking_for.body: Something cooperative with a short explanation would suit us. We will count the pieces carefully.

looking_for.author: u22
looking_for.title: Upholstery cleaner for a fabric chair
looking_for.body: The chair needs a freshen-up after storage. I would like to test a small hidden patch first.

looking_for.author: u23
looking_for.title: Music stands for a small ensemble
looking_for.body: We have the instruments but are short of two stands. Folding ones would be easiest to carry.

looking_for.author: u24
looking_for.title: Garden loppers for balcony branches
looking_for.body: A few thin branches need trimming before repotting. I do not need powered equipment.

looking_for.author: u25
looking_for.title: Reflector for an outdoor portrait exercise
looking_for.body: I am practising with a classmate in daylight. A collapsible reflector would be plenty.

looking_for.author: u26
looking_for.title: Whiteboard for exam revision
looking_for.body: We want to work through problems without using lots of paper. A portable board would fit our room.

looking_for.author: u27
looking_for.title: Reusable cups for a courtyard meetup
looking_for.body: We would rather wash a set than buy disposable cups. Around twenty should cover the group.

looking_for.author: u28
looking_for.title: Yoga mats for a beginner session
looking_for.body: Two clean mats would make it easier to practise together. We can bring carrying straps.

looking_for.author: u29
looking_for.title: Mixer for a birthday cake
looking_for.body: I have the ingredients and just need help with the mixing. A whisk attachment would be useful.

looking_for.author: u30
looking_for.title: Craft cutting mat for a model project
looking_for.body: Our project involves thin card and a ruler. A used mat is fine as long as it lies flat.

looking_for.author: u31
looking_for.title: Cooler for a picnic afternoon
looking_for.body: A small group is meeting in the park. A cooler that takes two ice packs would be enough.

looking_for.author: u32
looking_for.title: Desk lamp for a temporary workspace
looking_for.body: My usual desk is being moved. An adjustable lamp would help for a few evenings.

looking_for.author: u33
looking_for.title: Matching cards for a rainy afternoon
looking_for.body: A visiting child enjoys simple picture games. Large cards with easy-to-hold edges would work well.
